accounts.name: Warp
accounts.notes: Agentic terminal / dev environment; riff on running many agents from the terminal and seeing what each is doing.

accounts.name: Zed
accounts.notes: Fast Rust editor with built-in multiplayer and an agent panel (Agent Client Protocol); natural overlap on 'multiplayer for agents'.

accounts.name: Cognition (Devin)
accounts.notes: Makes Devin and owns Windsurf; engage on teams running many autonomous agents and how humans stay in the loop.

accounts.name: CodeRabbit
accounts.notes: AI code review on PRs; angle: review load explodes when a whole team's agents ship in parallel.

accounts.name: Railway
accounts.notes: App deployment platform; angle: agents shipping to prod fast, and knowing whose agent deployed what.

accounts.name: Neon
accounts.notes: Serverless Postgres with instant branching; angle: a database branch per agent/worktree.

accounts.name: PlanetScale
accounts.notes: Managed MySQL (Vitess) and Postgres with branching and deploy requests; banter on schema changes from parallel agents.

accounts.name: Convex
accounts.notes: Reactive TypeScript backend popular with AI app builders; angle: real-time sync for humans and agents alike.

accounts.name: Resend
accounts.notes: Email API for developers; light-touch engagement on dev-experience and launch posts.

accounts.name: Clerk
accounts.notes: Auth and user management; angle: agents scaffolding auth, and two agents both 'adding login'.

accounts.name: Sentry
accounts.notes: Error monitoring with AI debugging (Seer); angle: tracing a prod bug back to which agent wrote it.

accounts.name: Astral
accounts.notes: Fast Python tooling (uv, ruff, ty); engage on tooling speed that matters when agents run commands constantly.

accounts.name: tldraw
accounts.notes: Infinite canvas SDK with multiplayer and AI experiments; playful angle on visualizing a team's agents.

accounts.name: Mintlify
accounts.notes: Docs platform pushing llms.txt and AI-readable docs; angle: docs written for agents as the reader.

accounts.name: Factory
accounts.notes: Agent-native development with 'Droids' that take on full tasks; engage on delegating to many agents across a team.

accounts.name: Kiro
accounts.notes: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE, and a client Coordigent supports; angle: specs plus coordination when several devs' agents share a repo.

accounts.name: Cline
accounts.notes: Open-source coding agent for VS Code and the CLI, MCP-heavy community; engage on MCP servers and multi-agent workflows.

accounts.name: Modal
accounts.notes: Serverless compute for AI, including sandboxes; angle: spinning up many agent runs in parallel.

accounts.name: Sourcegraph
accounts.notes: Code search and understanding (Amp spun out in Dec 2025); angle: agents need codebase context and awareness of each other.

accounts.name: Greptile
accounts.notes: AI code review with full-codebase context; angle: reviewing PRs from many people's agents at once.

accounts.name: Graphite
accounts.notes: Stacked PRs and AI code review, acquired by Cursor (Dec 2025); angle: stacking and merging a team's agent-generated PRs.

accounts.name: Amp
accounts.notes: Frontier coding agent spun out of Sourcegraph; engage on agent workflows, threads and sharing agent work across a team.

accounts.name: Conductor
accounts.notes: Mac app that runs parallel Claude Code/Codex agents in isolated worktrees for one dev; be friendly, and position Coordigent as cross-teammate coordination (complementary), never knock them.

accounts.name: Roo Code
accounts.notes: Open-source VS Code coding agent with custom modes; engage on multi-mode/multi-agent setups and MCP.

accounts.name: Kilo Code
accounts.notes: Open-source coding agent for VS Code/JetBrains/CLI; engage on open-source agent tooling and team workflows.

accounts.name: Continue
accounts.notes: Open-source coding assistant and agents for IDE and CLI; engage on customizable agents and team-wide agent rules.

accounts.name: E2B
accounts.notes: Open-source cloud sandboxes for AI agents to run code; angle: many sandboxed agents still need to know about each other.

accounts.name: Daytona
accounts.notes: Fast, secure sandboxes for running AI-generated code; angle: parallel agent environments at team scale.

accounts.name: Browserbase
accounts.notes: Headless browsers for AI agents (Stagehand); engage on agents that test what other agents built.

accounts.name: Trigger.dev
accounts.notes: Open-source background jobs and long-running AI tasks in TypeScript; angle: long-running agents and handoffs.

accounts.name: Inngest
accounts.notes: Durable workflow and step-function engine, used for AI agents; angle: orchestration vs coordination.

accounts.name: Upstash
accounts.notes: Serverless Redis, queues (QStash) and vector DB; light engagement on agent infra and dev-experience posts.

accounts.name: Charm
accounts.notes: Delightful terminal tools (Bubble Tea, Gum) and the Crush coding agent; match their playful terminal-nerd tone.
